thresholdEvidence.notes: All ten reaches use the established conservative 300–2,000 cfs Verde planning band, with direct USGS 09506000 for the lower corridor. The band remains a planning cue, not a safety guarantee.

endpointAudit.notes: Coordinates and river-mile order come from the Friends of the Verde access map; every route preserves named RAPs as intermediate bailouts where applicable.

qualityControls.duplicateReview: forward access-chain pairs only; all ten endpoint combinations are new and distinct from the first expansion batch
